properties.description: A folder becomes ONE design, in the rounds a single document costs (crates/reflow2-core/tests/corpus.rs, 8 cases). The load-bearing four: two specs naming the same component converge on ONE node while each keeps its own provenance Fragment; three documents pin to ONE epoch, not three; a re-run reports the already-ingested document as SKIPPED and not failed, so resume is derived from the graph rather than bookmarked; and a document that cannot be taken is NAMED with why while its siblings still ingest. Plus the cost property — three documents cost the same ROUNDS as one, which is what makes a corpus affordable.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED: breaking the batching (gather one document per round instead of all) takes rounds 3 to 7 and documents_pending 3 to 1, and exactly the two tests that name those properties fail.
